title: Federated Soft Poly-Level Learning Over a Distributed Network with Guaranteed Convergence
abstract: arXiv:2611.17722v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-level learning/optimization, e.g., bilevel optimization, has been recognized for its versatile applicability across a broad array of domains, spanning from signal processing to machine learning. However, most existing works focus on bilevel and trilevel optimization. In contrast, multi-level optimization problems involving four or more hierarchical levels, which we term poly-level learning (PLL) problems, remain largely unexplored.In addition, in practical PLL, data may be distributed across multiple nodes over a distributed network. Nevertheless, extant studies on PLL predominantly focus on the non-federated setting, necessitating the collection of data to central servers and thereby posing potential privacy risks. To this end, we propose a Federated Poly-Level Learning (FPLL) framework over a distributed network to tackle the PLL problems with soft constraints in a federated manner. tldr: 该论文提出了联邦多层级学习框架FPLL，利用新颖的非线性割技术，在保证收敛性的前提下以联邦方式解决分布式网络上含软约束的四层级及以上的多层级优化问题，同时避免了数据集中带来的隐私风险。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Federated Poly-Level Learning (FPLL) framework that, leveraging a novel non-linear cut technique, solves soft-constrained poly-level optimization problems with four or more levels over distributed networks in a federated, privacy-preserving manner with guaranteed convergence.
